title: Reef Storm
briefing: Volatile Kestrel Air, steady Orchard Foods and red-hot Nimbus Cloud. A storm is coming to the reef. Momentum Max and Steady Stella are already sailing.
objective: Survive the storm: spread your money, size by risk, cap every position and use stops.
debrief: All three stocks rose for 19 days, Nimbus Cloud fastest at about 1.5% a day, tempting players to pile in. On day 19 regulators opened an accounting probe: Nimbus gapped down more than 20% and fell for three more days, and the whole Harbor 50 turned stormy, dragging Kestrel Air down too. Momentum Max and Steady Stella exited as their trends and stops broke. Players who capped each position, kept Nimbus small and used stops kept most of their gains.

news.headline: Regulators open an accounting probe into Nimbus Cloud
news.body: Regulators are investigating whether Nimbus Cloud reported sales too early. The company has delayed its results.

bonus.text: Keep every position at or under 30% of your portfolio
Keep Nimbus Cloud at or under 25% of your portfolio before day 19
Keep your worst drop within your plan's maximum loss
